t: Sagga | Encyclopedia.com
s: Sagga (Pāli, derived from Skt., svarga, ‘heaven, the next world’). In Buddhism, the pleasant conditions of reappearance (punabbhāva) which result from a life of moral, religious living. According to the Pāli canonical texts, sagga is not ‘heaven’ in spatial terms, in keeping with the early Buddhist non-cosmographical conceptions.
